Wholesale Manufacturing

Custom Corporate Uniforms, Manufactured to Order

Cotton Haven is a wholesale uniform manufacturer. We do not sell individual items — we partner with organisations, retailers and uniform programs to produce complete corporate uniform ranges, built exactly to your specifications.

Materials & Fabrics

Choose Your Fabric

We manufacture corporate uniforms in both woven and knit fabrics. Each fabric type has distinct properties suited to different garment styles and workplace requirements. Select the fabric that works for your uniform program — we'll do the rest.

Woven Fabrics

Woven fabrics are made by interlacing warp and weft yarns and are ideal for structured corporate garments — shirts, trousers, shorts, skirts, blazers, jackets and tunics — where shape retention, appearance and durability matter.

Poly Viscose
A popular suiting and shirting blend offering excellent drape and shape retention with a soft, smooth hand feel. Wrinkle-resistant and easy to care for — well suited to blazers, trousers and formal shirts.
Great drape Wrinkle-resistant Soft handle
Poly Wool & Poly Viscose Wool
Premium suiting fabrics that combine the natural warmth and structure of wool with the durability of polyester. Ideal for blazers, suit jackets and tailored trousers requiring a sharp, professional finish.
Natural warmth Sharp crease Durable
Poly Cotton
A versatile, widely used blend combining the breathability of cotton with the strength and easy-care properties of polyester. Suitable for shirts, trousers, shorts and workwear-style corporate garments.
Breathable Easy-care Cost-effective
100% Cotton
Natural, breathable and comfortable against the skin. Available in poplin, oxford and twill weave structures for shirts, blouses and lightweight corporate garments — particularly suited to warm climates.
Natural fibre Highly breathable Soft & comfortable
Stretch Woven (Spandex Blends)
Woven fabrics with a percentage of spandex or elastane added for two-way or four-way stretch. Provides comfort and ease of movement in structured garments such as trousers, skirts and fitted shirts.
Freedom of movement Shape-retaining Comfort fit
Twill, Drill & Poplin
Classic woven structures used across our corporate range. Twill and drill offer diagonal weave strength for trousers and workwear-style shirts; poplin delivers a crisp, smooth finish ideal for dress shirts and blouses.
Crisp finish Durable weave Professional appearance
Knit Fabrics

Knit fabrics are formed from looped yarn structures and offer natural stretch, comfort and ease of movement — ideal for polo shirts, jumpers, cardigans, sweaters and vests within a corporate uniform range.

Piqué Knit
The standard fabric for corporate polo shirts. A textured, breathable knit with a distinctive waffle-like surface that holds its shape and presents a smart, professional appearance.
Breathable texture Shape retention Classic polo look
Jersey & Interlock
Single jersey offers a lightweight, smooth fabric for corporate tees and polo underlayers. Interlock is a double-knit construction with greater stability and a finer finish, suitable for tailored corporate knits.
Smooth surface Lightweight Good drape
Rib Knit
A stretchy, vertically ribbed fabric commonly used for collar trims, cuffs and hem bands on jumpers, cardigans and polo shirts, as well as full-body ribbed garments with a close, body-conscious fit.
High stretch & recovery Close fit Trim & body use
Fleece & French Terry
Mid-weight knit fabrics for corporate jumpers, hoodies and casual outerwear. Fleece offers a soft, brushed interior for warmth; French terry has looped backing for comfortable, breathable layering pieces.
Warm & comfortable Easy-care Casual corporate
Performance Knits
Technical knit fabrics engineered for active or outdoor corporate environments. Features moisture-wicking, quick-dry and UPF protection properties — suitable for polo shirts, vests and functional corporate layers.
Moisture-wicking UPF protection Quick-dry
Mesh Knit
An open-structure knit fabric with excellent ventilation. Used for lightweight corporate polos and layering vests in warm-climate or high-activity environments where breathability is a priority.
Maximum airflow Lightweight Ventilation-focused

Common Questions

Corporate Uniform FAQs

What is the minimum order quantity for corporate uniforms?
Cotton Haven has no minimum order requirement — we accept orders from as little as 1 piece. Bulk pricing discounts apply at 25+, 100+ and 500+ units respectively. Contact us for a custom quote.
How long does production take for a corporate uniform order?
Standard production is 2–4 weeks from design approval. For complex orders with multiple garment types or large quantities, allow 4–6 weeks. Rush orders may be accommodated — ask your account manager.
Can you match our exact brand colours?
Yes. We work to your Pantone colour references for both fabric selection and embroidery thread. Colour accuracy is guaranteed across reorders, so your brand remains consistent over time.
What branding methods do you offer?
We offer embroidery (recommended for most corporate garments), screen printing, heat-transfer printing, woven labels, printed labels, branded buttons, and custom interior branding options such as monogrammed linings.
Do you provide samples before the full order?
Yes. We provide pre-production samples for all orders. Blank garment samples are available for fit approval, and branded samples are produced after design sign-off. Samples are charged at cost and credited against your full order.
Do you offer a uniform management programme for ongoing orders?
Yes. For corporate clients with 50+ staff, we offer managed uniform programmes including stock holding, individual name/size allocation, online ordering portals, and regular replenishment schedules. Contact us to discuss a tailored programme.
